attacks.name: Hellfire Lash
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Incinerate|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

attacks.name: Infernal Bargain
steps: After this attack is resolved, if |!damage| was dealt, this character gains a |<devils_deal>Devil's Deal| token.
If this attack would deal one or more |!damage|, it deals 1 |!damage| instead.

attacks.name: Termination Clause
steps: For each |<devils_deal>Devil's Deal| token this character has, add 1 die to its attack rolls for this attack.
After each attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§incinerate§Incinerate| special condition.

superPowers.name: Devil‘s Due
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 3 of this character. Spend 1 |<devils_deal>Devil's Deal| token. If you do, roll 5 dice. For each |!wild| rolled, the chosen character loses 1 |!power| and this character gains 1 |!power|. Then for each |!hit| rolled, the chosen character suffers 1 |!damage|. A character may be affected by this superpower only once per Round.

superPowers.name: How Can I be of Service?
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 3. Place this character within |!range| 1 of it. Then this character makes an |*Infernal Bargain| attack targeting that character. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Meet my Associate
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an attack, it may use this superpower. Spend 1 |<devils_deal>Devil's Deal| token. If you do, choose another allied character within |!range| 3 and Place it within |!range| 1 of this character. Then the chosen character becomes the new target of the attack regardless of |!range| and LOS.

superPowers.name: Demonic Contract
superPowers.body: This character may have a maximum of 3 |<devils_deal>Devil's Deal| tokens at any time and begins the game with 1 Devil's Deal token. During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power| for each Devil's Deal token it has.
